technique_name: Find the differences between the US Constitution and the French Constitution of 1958.
description: The United States Constitution was ratified in 1787, while the French Constitution of 1958 updated the post-World War II constitution. The US Constitution outlines the structure of government and spells out the enumerated and implied powers of the three branches: executive, legislative, and judicial.
